cohort: 210 parous women opting for IUD placement
finding: Negative perceptions of IUDs were the most significant predictor of pain during IUD insertion, while experience of vaginal delivery under epidural analgesia was associated with lower pain scores.
mod_finding: Experience of caesarean delivery was associated with higher pain scores during IUD insertion, while experience of vaginal delivery under epidural analgesia was associated with lower pain scores.
